app.title: Median XL — stash
err.data_missing.title: Game tables not found
err.data_missing.body:
Cannot read the game tables in the data/ folder ({file}).

Restart the editor and select the Median XL installation folder to extract them.
dlg.game_dir.title: Median XL installation folder
dlg.game_dir.first:
Select the Median XL installation folder (the folder that contains Game.exe and the medianxl-*.mpq files).

The editor extracts the game tables from it, and rebuilds them at each new version of the mod.
err.not_game_dir:
{path}

is not a Median XL installation folder (medianxl-YmludGJsdHh0.mpq not found).
dlg.rebuild.title: Game tables
ask.rebuild.missing:
The game tables must be extracted from the Median XL installation before first use:
{path} (version {version}).

Extract them now? (about 15 seconds)
ask.rebuild.unknown:
The game tables were extracted by an older version of the editor.

Rebuild them from {path} (version {version})? (about 15 seconds)
ask.rebuild.outdated:
A new version of Median XL was detected ({version}).

Rebuild the game tables now? (about 15 seconds)
ask.repair:
The game tables in data/ are incomplete or damaged: {n} file(s) missing or modified ({examples}).

Repair them from {path}? Only these files are extracted again (a few seconds).
repair.done: {n} file(s) repaired and verified: the game tables are intact.
repair.failed:
The damaged files could not be repaired one by one ({error}).

The game tables will be fully rebuilt.
ask.rebuild.ok:
The game tables are up to date (Median XL {version}) and intact: {files} files verified.

Rebuild them anyway? (about 15 seconds)
rebuild.done:
Game tables rebuilt (Median XL {version}): {n} icons, {missing} not found.
The previous tables are kept in data.old/.
err.rebuild:
The game tables could not be rebuilt; the previous ones are unchanged.
